title: Find the Longest Balanced Substring of a Binary String
sourceKind: fetched mirror page leetcode.doocs.org (statement, constraints and examples); search snippets also cite leetcode.com/problems/find-the-longest-balanced-substring-of-a-binary-string
summary: Given a binary string s, return the length of its longest balanced substring: all zeros come before all ones and the zero count equals the one count. The empty substring counts, so the answer can be 0.
visualizationNotes: Single left-to-right pass tracking the current zero run and following one run; each '1' closes a candidate of length 2 * min(zeros, ones). Input length is within the 50 limit so no cap is applied.
